reviewed_by: Codex primary agent with full-body reviews by government_output_evidence (positions 12-33), villach_quantity_schema (34-55), and north_star_explanation_review (56-76). Collaborative, outcome-exposed review; not independent or blind adjudication.
selection: Review all 65 complete retained calendar-2024 articles from the frozen current NIST CHIPS-filtered archive, including all 40 outside the preliminary-terms title flag. Include newly announced signed nonbinding manufacturing-incentive PMTs covering commercial semiconductor fabrication, packaging, materials and equipment. Retain source-native project, location and explicitly differentiated phase groups; do not invent individual identities for unnamed multi-fab groups or sum component counts into facilities. Keep separately identified research scopes excluded but visible. Final awards, research-only opportunities, workforce and governance articles are retained as article decisions rather than promoted to new PMT projects. Shared evidence and timing across related projects are not independent observations.
prior_exposure: Known outcomes and later guidance were already exposed before source selection and body review. The reviewers read all 65 current retained bodies, including final-award articles, while determining the PMT population. No new later-outcome acquisition or outcome adjudication was performed for this frozen project review. Publication metadata is context, not an Atlas issue time or proof of identical 2024 availability; all 65 pages carry 2025 modification metadata and were retained in September 2026. This current filtered archive can omit removed or differently tagged articles and is US-focused, not a global census. Later guidance is not backfilled into original PMT articles.
rights: Local review of exact NIST article bytes acquired under the separately retained archive and 65-article source reviews, with robots and copyrights/disclaimers policy checks. NIST's public-information notice retains marked-copyright and product-specific exceptions. Keep attribution and exact provenance; no raw redistribution, model training, issuer-site acquisition or scheduled-runtime transition is authorized by this review. Source semantics and date normalization are manual decisions, not independently established physical facts.
